text:
mari: quick microcopy pass — empty state + tooltips in Console. pasted screenshots in thread.
alex: looking now. which empty state specifically?
mari: the one when a project has no routes yet (Routes > Overview). current copy: "No routes configured. Create a route to start sending requests." feels generic and a little scary for new users.
sam: agreed. suggestion: "No routes yet — send your first request by creating a route. We’ll show live traffic and cost estimates once it’s active." shorter and sets expectation about what will appear.
jess: love telling them what to expect. tiny nit: "cost estimates" might worry some folks. maybe "usage estimates" or "token estimates"?
alex: +1 to "usage estimates". also accessibility: we use a blue link for "create a route" that is the only interactive thing — contrast is barely AA. raise link contrast or add underline.
mari: good catch. for the empty illustration alt text we currently have "empty routes illustration" — should be more descriptive: "illustration of an empty dashboard with no routes" for screenreaders.
ui-bot: suggestion: tooltip for the pin icon near model version. current tooltip: "Pin version". Proposal: "Pin model version — lock this route to a specific model version to avoid unexpected changes during rollouts." keeps it actionable.
sam: nice, but maybe shorter: "Pin this route to a model version to prevent automatic updates." also consider keyboard users: we should mention tooltip triggers on focus as well as hover.
jess: error message for deploy failures: currently shows modal with header "Deploy failed" and body "Something went wrong." can we surface the failure reason if available and a next step? e.g., "Deploy failed — CUDA OOM on host-a. Try reducing batch size or contact support."
alex: prefer using non-technical fallback for end users and a technical details toggle: top-level message: "Deploy failed — we couldn’t start the model. Try reducing batch size or try again." then an expandable "Show details" that shows the raw error for engineers.
mari: yes — and add copy for retry button: currently "Retry" — change to "Retry deploy" to be explicit in dialogs that are stacked.
sam: confirmation dialog when deleting a route: current copy: "Are you sure?" too terse. Proposed: header: "Delete route" body: "This will stop traffic to this route and delete its history. This action cannot be undone." primary button: "Delete route" secondary: "Cancel". Also add a checkbox for "I understand this will stop traffic" for critical routes.
jess: checkbox could slow down regular workflows. maybe only show checkbox if route has recent traffic or is production-tagged.
alex: accessibility: ensure dialog has role=alertdialog and focuses the first interactive element; ensure keyboard traps and Escape to cancel.
mari: short copy tweaks for small inline labels:
- current token counter label: "Tokens used" -> change to "Tokens (this request)" to clarify scope.
- toast after saving alert rules: "Saved" -> "Alert rule saved".
- generic 500 page: current: "Something broke" -> suggest "Service error — try refreshing or contact support with code 500-XYZ" and include copy for copying the error id.
sam: lgtm. thinking about tone: keep friendly but actionable. avoid passive voice.
ui-bot: accessibility nit for tooltips: tooltips should be reachable via focus, have aria-describedby, and persist while focused. ensure tooltip text length < 140 chars.
mari: last item: add microcopy for no-evals empty state: "No evals run yet — add a prompt set to run quality checks and compare model versions." include CTA: "Create eval".
alex: ok let's land these in a PR. mari can you make a small doc with current vs proposed copy lines? i'll strip for engineering and send to frontend.
mari: will do. thanks all :sparkles:)
